data.name: Aerosurfer
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the Skies: Where Flow, Focus, and Speed Collide

Easy to learn but difficult to master, this game will challenge you to prove yourself the best surfer in the sky. Strap on your wings and take off!

Floor is Lava

The closer to the ground you dare to fly, the more speed you will gain. But a single touch will end your run! Can you handle flying mere centimeters away from crashing catastrophically and top the leaderboards?

Features

🪽 Surf the Skies – Glide through varied tracks and feel your speed surge as you fly dangerously close to the terrain.

🎯 Pure Skill – Mastery comes from precision and timing. How good can you become?

👻 Race Your Ghost – Compete against your best time and refine your path run after run.

🌍 Online Leaderboards – See how you rank against players in the world and friends.

💨 Intense Sessions – Perfect for quick flights or long sessions chasing perfection.

Campaign

Compete across 24 carefully designed tracks as you progress through the campaign. These tracks will slowly build up your skill, offering a variety of challenges along the way. Tracks come in different modes:

🏁 Race to the Finish Line – Reach the finish line as fast as possible!

⭕ Collect the Rings – Fly through all the rings in any order you like. Find the best path!

Puzzle Tracks

Unlock a set of extra hard challanges by completing the Campaign. These additional tracks function like puzzles where you need to first create a strategy for how to complete the track, then execute on it flawlessly. Caution: very hard!

Hidden Collectibles

Want to take a break from chasing high scores? Find dozens of hidden collectibles scattered throughout the game. Explore the tracks and re-discover them from a different perspective. The main menu also offers a large open area to fly around and relax in (about 16 km²).

Find your rhythm. Chase perfection. Become an Ace of the Air in Aerosurfer!

data.short_description: Your hands turn into wings in this speedrunning VR game. The closer to the ground you fly, the faster you'll go – but don't crash! Take to the skies and see how fast you can fly through 30 handcrafted tracks.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Core i5-7500 / Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 / RX 580 - 2GB VRAM
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR, requires motion controllers
